title: dnaa-3 readouts — reproduced on the dnaa-4 reference config (linear s=0.6 + F-05)
caption: All dnaa-3 readouts over the full lineage, rendered from the dnaa-4 autoregulation REFERENCE run (dnaa4_s06_F05_seed1_12gen) — the SAME configuration/parameters as dnaa-4 (linear s=0.6 + F-05, V=1.5e-3, k_h=0.025), per Rashmi 2026-06-16/06-20. The DnaA-ATP/ADP fraction (panel 2) is now computed with the CANONICAL definition shared with dnaa-4: fraction = (free + bound) / total DnaA, via scripts/dnaa_observables.py. Under the active Langmuir binding DnaA-ATP is ~98% BOUND (~94 bound vs ~2 free), so the earlier free-only fraction was meaningless (near-zero denominator, swinging 0->1); the canonical gen-mean fraction sits in the [0.2,0.5] band (g3+ mean 0.254), identical to dnaa-4 (mean/range/std match exactly). Six panels (time in minutes): (1) total DnaA concentration (free+bound); (2) DnaA-ATP & DnaA-ADP fraction — per-tick + gen-mean overlay vs the [0.2,0.5] band; (3) number of oriC (1<->2); (4) DnaA in all forms (free + bound); (5) DnaA boxes free vs bound, doubling across replication; (6) cell mass.
interpretation: This fixes the chart Rashmi flagged (2026-06-20): study 3's DnaA-ATP ratios are NOT off — they were being computed the wrong way (free-only instead of free+bound). On the dnaa-4 reference config, with the canonical (free+bound)/total fraction, the dnaa-3 readouts reproduce the dnaa-4 picture: clean 12/12 cell cycle (oriC 1<->2), DnaA pool self-stabilized, DnaA-ATP fraction gen-mean in [0.2,0.5] (0.254, identical to dnaa-4). The per-tick fraction swings (real charging dynamics, present in dnaa-4 too); the generation mean is the in-band signal.
script: scripts/render_dnaa3_readouts.py (DnaA-ATP fraction via scripts/dnaa_observables.py — shared with dnaa-4)
